description.value: Mr Mikes is a Canadian casual steakhouse chain with roots going back to 1960, now branded as 'SteakhouseCasual' — a relaxed, unpretentious sit-down experience built around affordable premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and shareable appetizers. The Duncan location welcomes walk-ins and offers both dine-in and takeout, making it a solid option for a substantial post-ride meal. The chain prides itself on a come-as-you-are attitude with no dress code.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the Duncan location is fully loaded and confirms the OSM address (2763 Beverly Street), phone (250-715-2070), and that the business is actively operating with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. Takeout is confirmed by the 'Order for Takeout' call-to-action on the location page. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those fields remain null per evidence-only rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible full-service restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and active online ordering. Useful to touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Duncan.
